drivers: Simple Latin-square distribution: each row/column contains one of each shape-fill combo, with constant count and rotation
Shape and fill are perfectly bundled (pentagon=empty, triangle=solid, arrow=striped), so one rule suffices
Distractors vary count (5 vs 4) and shape/fill mismatches, requiring attention to both features but easily eliminated
Generous 75 s limit for a low working-memory item
